level1.title: Be Faithful in Little Things
level1.story: Jesus told about a servant who was not honest with his master's money. Jesus said, "Whoever is faithful in little things is faithful in big things." You cannot serve God and money.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus say about little things?
What little thing can you do well?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me be faithful. Amen.

activity.title: Faithful in little things
activity.intro: Stamp or draw a star each time you do a small job well.
rows: A little thing I did well

level2.title: The Dishonest Steward
level2.story: Jesus told of a rich man's steward who was accused of wasting his goods. Knowing he would lose his job, the steward cleverly reduced what the debtors owed his master. Jesus said, "He that is faithful in that which is least, is faithful also in that which is greater." If we are not faithful with earthly riches, who will trust us with true riches? Jesus said, "You cannot serve God and mammon."
level2.keyLine: You cannot serve God and mammon.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does Jesus praise the steward's shrewdness, not his dishonesty?
How can you be faithful in small things?
actions: Give part of my money to God
level2.prayer: Lord, I choose to serve You alone. Amen.

activity.title: Commandments in action
activity.intro: Match each commandment to a daily action.
pairs: Be happy with what I have
